en:
"Hey, isn't it about time we went home?"
Fukuzawa stood up.{p}

"You're right. Well then, let's call it a day.
Thank you all so much for coming today."{p}

"I had fun today.
So, {b}, shall we walk home together?"
"Kazama... I still have to clean up in here."
I gave him a light reply and saw them all off.{p}

...Well, then.
Tomorrow I have to go see Hino first thing.
I'll report that the seventh one never showed up, too.
Who on earth had he invited, anyway...?{p}

When I reported it the next day, Hino laughed and said,
"Ah, sorry, sorry.
I forgot to tell you.
The seventh wonder is something special I'm saving.
I figured I'd leave it for later."
"For later?"
"Yeah, that's right.
For now, just write the six scary stories up into an article for me.
We'll talk after that."
"Oh, okay."
What could the seventh wonder be?
Something special he's saving...{p}

I took my leave.
After I'd walked a little way, Hino called out to me from behind.
"{a}!"
"...Yes?"{p}

And then about a week went by.
Just as Hino had said, I wrote the six scary stories up into an article.
He told me to leave the rest to him, but what was he going to do about the last story?
And the paper was coming out tomorrow.....................{p}
